title: Vibhishana brings Seetha to Rama
introduction: Rama sends Vibhishana to bring Seetha to his presence. Vibhishana brings Seetha to Rama's presence. Seetha casts her looks on the moon-like face of Rama, her beloved husband.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुर्दशाधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 114th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तमुवाच महाप्रज्ञमभिगम्य प्लवङ्गमः |
रामं वचनमर्थज्ञो वरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्
verses.iast:
tamuvāca mahāpraGYamabhigamya plavañgamaḥ |
rāmaṃ vacanamarthaGYo varaṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām
verses.translation: Having offered his salutation to that Rama, who was excellent among all the wielders of the bow and whose eyes resembled the lotus-petals, that highly intelligent Hanuma spoke to him as follows:

glosses.meaning: who was excellent among all the wielders of the bow
and whose eyes resembled the louts-petals.

verses.devanagari:
यन्निमित्तोऽयमारम्भः कर्मणां च फलोदयः |
तां देवीं शोकसन्तप्तां मैथिलीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
yannimitto'yamārambhaḥ karmaṇāṃ ca phalodayaḥ |
tāṃ devIṃ śokasantaptAṃ maithilIṃ draṣṭumarhasi
verses.translation: "You ought to see Seetha that divine lady who is consumed by grief, for whose sake this course of actions was undertaken and which has (now) borne fruit."

verses.devanagari:
सा हि शोकसमाविष्टा बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा |
मैथिली विजयं श्रुत्वा तव हर्षमुपागमत्
verses.iast:
sā hi śokasamāviṣṭā bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā |
maithilI vijayaṃ śrutvā tava harṣamupāgamat
verses.translation: "Hearing the news of your victory, that Seetha, stricken as she was with grief, is now longing to see you, her eyes filled with tears of joy."

glosses.meaning: stricken as she was with grief
her eyes filled with tears of joy.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वकात्प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तो विश्वस्तया तया |
भर्तारं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि कृतार्थं सहलक्ष्मणम्
verses.iast:
pUrvakātpratyayāccāhamukto viśvastayā tayā |
bhartāraṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kṛtārthaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam
verses.translation: "By her, who has trust in me because of confidence which has trust in me because of confidence which had been inspired me on a former occasion, I was spoken as follows: 'I desire to see my husband, who has accomplished his purpose, together with Lakshmana.'"

glosses.meaning: because of confidence which had been inspired by me

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो धर्मभृतां वरः |
अगच्छत्सहसा ध्यानमासीद्बाष्पपरिप्लुतः
verses.iast:
evamukto hanumatā rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ |
agacchatsahasā dhyānamāsIdbāṣpapariplutaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing Hanuma's words, Rama who was the foremost among the supporters of righteousness, was a little over whelmed with tears and suddenly became a bit thoughtful.

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घमुष्णं च निश्वस्य मेदिनीम् अवलोकयन् |
उवाच मेघसङ्काशं विभीषणमुपस्थितम्
verses.iast:
dIrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niśvasya medinIm avalokayan |
uvāca meghasañkāśaṃ vibhIṣaṇamupasthitam
verses.translation: Drawing a deep and warm breath and casting his looks on the ground, he spoke (as follows) to Vibhishana, who closely resembled a cloud in hue and who was standing nearby.

glosses.meaning: Drawing a deep and warm breath
who closely resembled a cloud in hue

verses.devanagari:
दिव्याङ्गरागां वैदेहीं दिव्याभरणभूषिताम् |
इह सीतां शिरःस्नातामुपस्थापय माचिरम्
verses.iast:
divyāñgarāgāṃ vaidehIṃ divyābharaṇabhUṣitām |
iha sItāṃ śiraḥsnātāmupasthāpaya māciram
verses.translation: "Bring here Seetha, after she has bathed her head, has been anointed with charming cosmetics and adorned with beautiful jewels. Let there be no delay."

glosses.meaning: after she has bathed her head
has been anointed with charming cosmetics

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण त्वरमाणो विभीषणः |
प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं सीतां स्त्रीभिः स्वाभिरचोदयत्
verses.iast:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa tvaramāṇo vibhIṣaṇaḥ |
praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ sItāṃ strIbhiḥ svābhiracodayat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Vibhishana, after entering the gynaecium in haste, communicated his presence to Seetha, through his own women.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सीतां महाभागां दृष्ट्वोवाच विभीषणः |
मूर्ध्नि बद्धाञ्जलिः श्रीमान्विनीतो राक्षसेश्वरः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sītāṃ mahābhāgāṃ dṛṣṭvovāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
mūrdhni baddhāJṇjaliḥ śrīmānvinīto rākṣaseśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then, the glorious Vibhishana the king of demons, after seeing the highly fortunate Seetha, with his palms joined over his head, humbly spoke to her as follows:

verses.devanagari:
दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेही दिव्याभरणभूषिता |
यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति
verses.iast:
divyāñgarāgā vaidehI divyābharaṇabhUṣitā |
yānamāroha bhadraṃ te bhartā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati
verses.translation: "O Seetha! Anointed with charming cosmetics and adorned with beautiful jewels if you please, mount on the vehicle. Your husband wants to see you."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम् |
अस्नाता द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसाधिप
verses.iast:
evamuktā tu vaidehI pratyuvāca vibhIṣaṇam |
asnātā draṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṃ rākṣasādhipa
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Vibhishana, replied as follows: "O king of demons! I wish to see my husband, even without taking my bath."

glosses.meaning: to Vibhishana (as follows): raakShaseshvara = O king of demons!

verses.devanagari:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः |
यथाहं रामो भर्ता ते तत्तथा कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhIṣaṇaḥ |
yathāhaṃ rāmo bhartā te tattathā kartumarhasi
verses.translation: Hearing those words of Seetha, Vibhishana replied as follows: "You ought to do the bidding of Rama, your husband, as he has enjoined you to do."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मैथिली भ्रातृदेवता |
भर्तृभक्तिव्रता साध्वी तथेति प्रत्यभाषत
verses.iast:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maithilI bhrātṛdevatā |
bhartṛbhaktivratā sādhvI tatheti pratyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Hearing those words of Vibhishana, the virtuous Seetha, regarding her husband as a divinity, endowed as she was with a devotion to her husband, said in reply, "So t be!"

glosses.meaning: regarding her husband as a divinity
with a devotion to her husband

verses.devanagari:
ततः सीतां शिरःस्नातां युवतीभिरलङ्कृताम् |
महार्हाभरणोपेतां महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम्
आरोप्य शिबिकां दीप्तां परार्ध्याम्बरसंवृताम् |
रक्षोभिर्बहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहार विभीषणः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sItāṃ śiraḥsnātāṃ yuvatIbhiralañkṛtām |
mahārhābharaṇopetāṃ mahārhāmbaradhāriṇIm
āropya śibikāṃ dIptāṃ parārdhyāmbarasaṃvṛtām |
rakṣobhirbahubhirguptāmājahāra vibhIṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Prevailing upon Seetha to ascend a shining palanquin, covered with an exceedingly valuable cloth and guarded by numerous demons, after she had bathed her head and cleansed her body, had put on costly robes and had been adorned with exceedingly valuable jewels, Vibhishana then brought her to the presence of Rama.

glosses.meaning: covered with an exceedingly valuable cloth
after she has bathed her head
after making use of toilet and other cleansing facilities
had put on very costly robes
and had been adorned with exceedingly valuable jewels.

verses.devanagari:
सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं ज्ञात्वाभिध्यानमास्थितम् |
प्रणतश्च प्रहृष्टश्च प्राप्तां सीतां न्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
so'bhigamya mahātmānaṃ GYātvābhidhyānamāsthitam |
praṇataśca prahṛṣṭaśca prāptāṃ sItāṃ nyavedayat
verses.translation: Approaching the great-souled Rama, who was absorbed in thought, even after coming to know that Seetha had arrived, Vibhishana offered his obeisance and with full of great joy, announced to him that Seetha had arrived.

glosses.meaning: even after coming to know that Seetha had arrived
and with full of great joy

verses.devanagari:
तामागतामुपश्रुत्य रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम् |
हर्षो दैन्यं च रोषश्च त्रयं राघवमाविशत्
verses.iast:
tāmāgatāmupaśrutya rakṣogṛhaciroṣitām |
harṣo dainyaṃ ca roṣaśca trayaṃ rāghavamāviśat
verses.translation: Hearing that Seetha had arrived after living long in the abode of a demon, Rama was filled with joy, indignation and felt miserable too all the three emotions at the same time.

glosses.meaning: after living long in the abode of a demon

verses.devanagari:
ततः पार्श्वगतं दृष्ट्वा सविमर्शं विचारयन् |
विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहृष्टो राघवोऽब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ pārśvagataṃ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṃ vicārayan |
vibhIṣaṇamidaṃ vākyamahṛṣṭo rāghavo'bravIt
verses.translation: Feeling unhappy on considering with deep thought, the question of Seetha having come in a palanquin, all the way, Rama then spoke the following words, looking at Vibhishana who was beside him.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत |
वैदेही संनिकर्षं मे शीघ्रं समुपगच्छतु
verses.iast:
rākṣasādhipate saumya nityaṃ madvijaye rata |
vaidehI saṃnikarṣaṃ me śIghraṃ samupagacchatu
verses.translation: "O the gently king of demons, who is forever intent on my victory! Let Seetha duly seek my presence quickly."

glosses.meaning: O the gentle king of demons

verses.devanagari:
स तद्वचनमाज्ञाय राघवस्य विभीषणः |
तूर्णमुत्सारणे यत्नं कारयामास सर्वतः
verses.iast:
sa tadvacanamāGYāya rāghavasya vibhIṣaṇaḥ |
tUrṇamutsāraṇe yatnaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words of that Rama, Vibhishana, who knew what was right, began to disperse the crowd there quickly.

verses.devanagari:
कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणस्तत्र वेत्रझर्झरपाणयः |
उत्सारयन्तः पुरुषाः समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः
verses.iast:
kañcukoṣṇIṣiṇastatra vetrajharjharapāṇayaḥ |
utsārayantaḥ puruṣāḥ samantātparicakramuḥ
verses.translation: Demons wearing jackets and turbans, their hands carrying staffs which made a jingling sound, walked there all round, dispersing those warriors.

glosses.meaning: their hands carrying staffs which made a jingling sound

verses.devanagari:
ऋक्षाणां वानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वतः |
वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानि दूरमुत्ससृजुस्ततः
verses.iast:
ṛkṣāṇāṃ vānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca sarvataḥ |
vṛndānyutsāryamāṇāni dUramutsasṛjustataḥ
verses.translation: Crowds of bears, monkeys and demons, dispersed on all sides, bounced for a distance, from their nearness to the palanquin.

verses.devanagari:
तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानां सर्वेषां ध्वनिरुत्थितः |
वायुनोद्वर्तमानस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.iast:
teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhvanirutthitaḥ |
vāyunodvartamānasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
verses.translation: While those warriors were being driven away, there was a very great sound, resembling the roar of a sea, lashed by a storm.

glosses.meaning: while they were being dispersed (in that way)

verses.devanagari:
उत्सार्यमाणांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा समन्ताज्जातसम्भ्रमान् |
दाक्षिण्यात्तदमर्षाच्च वारयामास राघवः
verses.iast:
utsāryamāṇāṃstāndṛṣṭvā samantājjātasambhramān |
dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣācca vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing them being dispersed on all sides excited, Rama then stopped that operation of those who were dispersing them, out of kindness (for those who were being driven away) and resentment (at the behaviour of the demons who were dispersing them).

glosses.meaning: them being dispersed on all sides
out of kindness (for those who were being driven away)
and resentment (at the behaviour of the demons who were dispersing them).

verses.devanagari:
संरब्धश्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव |
विभीषणं महाप्राज्ञं सोपालम्भमिदं वचः
verses.iast:
saṃrabdhaścābravIdrāmaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva |
vibhIṣaṇaṃ mahāprāGYaṃ sopālambhamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: The enraged Rama, consuming the demons with his looks as it were, Rama spoke the following reproaching words to the highly intelligent Vibhishana

glosses.meaning: with his looks as though burning
spoke idam vachaH = the follwoing words

verses.devanagari:
किमर्थं मामनादृत्य कृश्यतेऽयं त्वया जनः |
निवर्तयैनमुद्योगं जनोऽयं स्वजनो मम
verses.iast:
kimarthaṃ māmanādṛtya kṛśyate'yaṃ tvayā janaḥ |
nivartayainamudyogaṃ jano'yaṃ svajano mama
verses.translation: "Why disregarding me, are these people harassed by you? Stop this exertion. They are my own people."

verses.devanagari:
न गृहाणि न वस्त्राणि न प्राकारास्तिरस्क्रियाः |
नेदृशा राजसत्कारा वृत्तमावरणं स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyāḥ |
nedṛśā rājasatkārā vṛttamāvaraṇaṃ striyaḥ
verses.translation: "An apartment is not a thing that protects a woman, nor robes, nor compound-walls, nor concealments nor such royal honours. Her character is her shield."

verses.devanagari:
व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धे न स्वयं वरे |
न क्रतौ नो विवाहे च दर्शनं दुष्यते स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddhe na svayaṃ vare |
na kratau no vivāhe ca darśanaṃ duṣyate striyaḥ
verses.translation: "A woman becoming visible to public in times of a calamity is not condemned in difficult situations, nor in battles, nor in self-choosing of a husband by a princess at a public assembly of suitors, nor in sacrificial ceremonies nor in marriage-functions."

glosses.meaning: in self-choosing of a husband by a princess at a public assemly of suitors

verses.devanagari:
सैषा युद्धगता चैव कृच्छ्रे महति च स्थिता |
दर्शनेऽस्या न दोषः स्यान्मत्समीपे विशेषतः
verses.iast:
saiṣā yuddhagatā caiva kṛcchre mahati ca sthitā |
darśane'syā na doṣaḥ syānmatsamIpe viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "The younder Seetha is in distress and beset with a great difficulty. There is no fault in her appearance in public, particularly in my presence."

glosses.meaning: in her becoming visible in public

verses.devanagari:
विसृज्य शिबिकां तस्मात्पद्भ्यामेवोपसर्पतु |
समीपे मम वैदेहीं पश्यन्त्वेते वनौकसः
verses.iast:
visṛjya śibikāṃ tasmātpadbhyāmevopasarpatu |
samīpe mama vaidehīṃ paśyantvete vanaukasaḥ
verses.translation: "That is why, let her come on foot alone, leaving the palanquin there. Let these monkeys see Seetha in my presence."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण सविमर्शो विभीषणः |
रामस्योपानयत्सीतां संनिकर्षं विनीतवत्
verses.iast:
evamuktastu rāmeṇa savimarśo vibhIṣaṇaḥ |
rāmasyopānayatsItāṃ saṃnikarṣaṃ vinItavat
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama the intelligent Vibhishana, with decency, brought Seetha to Rama's vicinity.

verses.devanagari:
ततो लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ हनूमांश्च प्लवङ्गमः |
निशम्य वाक्यं रामस्य बभूवुर्व्यथिता भृशम्
verses.iast:
tato lakṣmaṇasugrIvau hanUmāṃśca plavañgamaḥ |
niśamya vākyaṃ rāmasya babhUvurvyathitā bhṛśam
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, Lakshmana Sugreeva and Hanuma the monkey then felt very much perturbed.

verses.devanagari:
कलत्रनिरपेक्षैश्च इङ्गितैरस्य दारुणैः |
अप्रीतमिव सीतायां तर्कयन्ति स्म राघवम्
verses.iast:
kalatranirapekṣaiśca iñgitairasya dāruṇaiḥ |
aprItamiva sItāyāṃ tarkayanti sma rāghavam
verses.translation: From the pitiless facial features of Rama, showing indifference to his consort, they conjectured as if Rama had some displeasure towards Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
लज्जया त्ववलीयन्ती स्वेषु गात्रेषु मैथिली |
विभीषणेनानुगता भर्तारं साभ्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
lajjayā tvavalIyantI sveṣu gātreṣu maithilI |
vibhIṣaṇenānugatā bhartāraṃ sābhyavartata
verses.translation: Seetha, for her part, shrinking into her limbs with modesty, approached her husband, duly followed by Vibhishana.

verses.devanagari:
विस्मयाच्च प्रहर्षाच्च स्नेहाच्च परिदेवता |
उदैक्षत मुखं भर्तुः सौम्यं सौम्यतरानना
verses.iast:
vismayācca praharṣācca snehācca paridevatā |
udaikṣata mukhaṃ bhartuḥ saumyaṃ saumyatarānanā
verses.translation: The pleasant-faced Seetha, who considered her husband as the divinity, saw the charming face of her husband, with a surprise, rejoice and affection.

glosses.meaning: who considered her husband as the divinity

verses.devanagari:
अथ समपनुदन्मनःक्लमं सा |
सुचिरमदृष्टमुदीक्ष्य वै प्रियस्य |
वदनमुदितपूर्णचन्द्रकान्तं |
विमलशशाङ्कनिभानना तदासीत्
verses.iast:
atha samapanudanmanaḥklamaṃ sā |
suciramadṛṣṭamudIkṣya vai priyasya |
vadanamuditapUrṇacandrakāntaṃ |
vimalaśaśāñkanibhānanā tadāsIt
verses.translation: Seeing the face of her beloved husband, which had not been seen for a long time and which was charming like the rising full moon, she forth dispelled her mental fatigue.

glosses.meaning: with her face resembling the bright moon
and which was charming like the rising full-moon
